title: dactylis glomerata var. aschersoniana
intro: Dactylis glomerata var. aschersoniana, commonly known as Ascherson's cocksfoot or Ascherson's bentgrass, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis glomerata var. aschersoniana involve soothing digestive irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
